title: Half an ULP Decides: Predicting Which BF16 Updates Need Stochastic Rounding
topic: predicting stale bfloat16 weight updates half ulp selective stochastic rounding without FP32 master weights
novelty_queries: BF16 stochastic rounding optimizer master weights
stale updates bfloat16 rounding weight update
goal: Explain why pure-BF16 training stalls (updates below half an ulp round away), show that a half-ulp test predicts exactly which updates stall, and that stochastically rounding only those parameters matches FP32 master weights at a fraction of the random-bit cost.
